name: CSS Innocent Passage
note: R1.7, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.30 (PDF p.31). The small freighter chassis every Q-ship shares, with ISC guns bolted into it - the owner's summary was exactly right, and the chassis was verified box by box against gorn/sq.json rather than copied on faith: armor 3, C hull 4 (two boxes fore and two aft), cargo 10 in a 2x5 block, warp TWO a side, impulse 1, APR 4, batteries 3, transporters 2, tractors 2, two shuttle boxes, shields 10 all round, excess damage 2, crew 6, boarding parties 5, and the damage tracks 4-2-0, 6-4-0, 0-0-9. Every one of those is the Gorn small Q-ship's. WHAT DIFFERS IS THE ARMAMENT AND THE HELM: TWO plasma-F, A to port and B to starboard, where the Gorn carries ONE at FA - and a phaser-1 at FX with a phaser-3 at 360 rather than the Gorn's phaser-3 forward and phaser-1s on the flanks. Turn mode C against the Gorn's D, and 39 points against 35. THESE PLASMA-F ARE NOT R13.1C's REAR-FIRING KIND. They sit in side arcs, which looks like the Star Cruiser's arrangement and is not: the sheet makes no R13.1C reference, and its pseudo-plasma box lists type-F pseudos for BOTH launchers, where R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes have none. So no iscRearFiring flag here, deliberately. NO HET: the turn mode table prints 'NO HET' rather than a cost, which is what bonusHets 0 says. The acceleration note is the Q-ship wording - 'no more than five movement points OR DOUBLE its current speed' - so maxAccel 5 with C2.21's doubling arm left in place, unlike a plain freighter's hard cap. The Y180 Sabot refit (+2) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope.
